name: const unsafe fn as_ref_unchecked < 'a > (self) -> & 'a T
rule: For safety, as_ref_unchecked must not be used if self may be null; as_ref must be used instead when the value is known to be initialized, and as_uninit_ref must be used instead when the value may be uninitialized.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > * const T { const unsafe fn as_ref_unchecked < 'a > (self) -> & 'a T }
